lessons.applicability: Equivalent real loop guards can retain different compiler comparison pseudos. In this clean nonmatching pair, index<count survives FLOW, becomes a USE in COMBINE and receives an eight-byte slot during allocation; count>0 loses it and shrinks the frame. Inspect source-bound stages before inferring a missing field. Preserve real index/bound producers, widths and zero-iteration behavior; never manufacture references or padding. Transfer and whole-function acceptance remain unproved.

A shared arithmetic result can inherit a spill register or let later loads move early. In this clean nonmatching example, real multiply/divide/store tails in alternative arms retained a join through allocation; late-jump then merged the tails while preserving the inserted reload. Compare the shared-quotient counterexample and source-bound dumps. Preserve executed operations and real conditions; this is local compiler evidence, not original-source proof or whole-function acceptance.

Final delay-slot placement can hide the earlier lifetime used for allocation. In this clean nonmatching source pair, placing the real index initialization inside its guard restored register homes; initializing the actual packet base before the next guard supplied its delay slot. Source-bound allocation, sched2 and dbr dumps distinguish these stages. Preserve real uses and zero-iteration behavior; local instruction correspondence is not whole-function acceptance or a universal recipe.

If a real pointer disappears into a biased induction variable, inspect loop-pass combination and profitability. Moving its genuine increment into existing alternative paths prevented reduction in this clean nonmatching example and restored base-plus-field addressing. Preserve one increment per original path and operation order. Baseline evidence is native-only; stage facts belong to the changed source. Final tail merging and other registers remain unresolved; this is not a general rule.

When a scalar or pointer spans distinct real producers, compare phases at existing reloads or lifetime boundaries, preserving zero-iteration and retained-value consumers. In this clean nonmatching loop context, phase separation restored several register and stack assignments; the loop-form-only control worsened allocation despite the intended relative order. Inspect the full allocation, not a two-variable ratio. No invented uses or runtime work; no original-source or whole-match claim.

For a single-set unsigned numerator, inspect equivalent side-effect-free comparisons and destination propagation. The cited trace shows quotient/remainder allocation and reciprocal scheduling changes; inspect named-destination and first-operand counterexamples. These nonmatching contexts contain inherited artificial filter references, ineligible for final source. The measured component effect requires replay without those references; it is not an accepted match or general operand-order recipe.

Sharing a real case/default body changed early and distant reload choices; late merging can hide an earlier allocated producer. Preserve the switch mapping. The earlier trace and direct-pair parent have distinct identities. These nonmatching contexts contain inherited artificial filter references, ineligible for final source. Replay the component without them before relying on transfer; this is neither a universal parity rule nor evidence of retail's original source.

For the evidenced allocator-result/owner-load ordering conflict, inspect identical arms containing the real clear, copy and saved-byte load. The low-bit form transferred between two Actor functions; a full-null condition specializes an argument, and CF0's first site changes other registers. Preserve complete behavior; no pointer-bit meaning or exact compiler-pass mechanism is established.

Compare the coupled word-element spelling of a real clear and direct owner argument after allocation. The source form transferred from 159D0 to CF0's first site, while its second site needed the distinct duplication form. Neither component alone nor the proposed memory-class/pass mechanism is established by these observations; compare the complete source pairs.

For repeated constructor sites with verified body coverage, compare per-site single-set locals against the genuine loaded values shared across sites. This source-context experiment is not a universal allocator recipe.

When a real classifier result becomes a Boolean-to-index expression instead of the observed branch, inspect the separate word result and narrowed byte index. Preserve actual uses; do not introduce dummy carriers or infer original types.
Check CFG, widths and ABI prerequisites, then compare scoped local lifetimes and load order. No global register preference is established.
For a cursor load displaced by an independent store, inspect the retained-load examples and their limits.
Multiple related stack offsets may justify one local aggregate experiment. The cited experiment remained nonmatching.
Use instruction-supported widths, branch targets and grouping before changing allocator choices; the note distinguishes exact and nonmatching cases.
When the straight-line tail and dependencies already agree, inspect the bounded independent-store ordering experiment.
An independently supported symbol can change address materialization. Do not invent symbols or infer relocation intent from similarity.
